item.title: How I Configure LLMs on a Budget (in Brazil)
item.author: contact@vmmazz.com (Victor Mota Mazzei)
item.description: The goal of this post is to share how I configured my OpenCode setup to get the best cost-to-performance ratio I&rsquo;ve found so far. The ideas, opinions, architecture, experiences, and conclusions presented here are entirely my own. Before we get started, here&rsquo;s a bit of context.
